title: Does not fit 2 sticks
text: Does not fit 2 sticks. I am so tired of the misleading descriptions. This does not fit two sticks of butter because the lid will not fit over 2 sticks!!!! There is a gap at the whale tail and it is obvious the lid is not fitting down over both sticks.

product_metadata.title: Fox Run Whale Ceramic Butter Dish with Lid, 7", Aqua Blue
features: MAINTAIN FRESHNESS: This butter dish maintains a spreadable consistency for your butter. No more scraping through toast and bagels; enjoy butter that actually spreads like butter!

HIGH QUALITY STORAGE keeps butter hygienically enclosed at room temperature and shielded from kitchen odors and mess; large enough to hold 2 sticks of butter, or a block of cream cheese. Not to mention, it's microwave, oven, and dishwasher safe!

CONVENIENT AND CUTE HANDLE/TAIL: Easy-to-lift tail is cleverly shaped as a handle for convenient access to your butter right when you need it; Keep hands mess-free while keeping butter within easy reach at breakfast or throughout the day!

ENJOY THE "SPLASH" OF COLOR: This whimsical whale design is a perfect accent for almost any kitchen. In combination with the beautiful aqua blue pastel color, it's the perfect accent to any beach house or modern kitchen decor.
MEASUREMENTS: This butter dish weighs 1.81 pounds and has dimensions of 4.5 x 7.25 x 4 inches.
description: With an Aqua Blue pastel and whale-shaped design, this dish brings a fun and practical seaside highlight to your kitchen table and counter. Protect and store butter after each use while keeping fresh at room temperature, and safely shielded from unwanted kitchen odors. Leave out to brighten up breakfast or bring out for special occasions As a fun way to present cheeses and chocolates.
